- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 25
- Description: Directed Kirsten QR batch scope — quantity call (38 vs 39), delivery format, provenance-format requirement
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/39
  
  Details:
  Time spent directing the Kirsten chocolate-bar QR request this morning.
  
  WHAT GARY DID
  1. Relayed Kirsten's request: loose-cacao-nib chocolate bars needed QR codes, "she mentioned 39".
  2. Caught my muddled framing when I narrated minting and rendering as one step — his "I thought we are using your python script to generate the QR codes?" forced the distinction that mattered: minting = creating 38 identifiers as sheet rows (Edgar's job), rendering = batch_compiler.py turning those rows into labels. That correction is what got the work back on the sanctioned path.
  3. Made the quantity decision: ruled 38 over 39 on the 40-produced-minus-2-sold arithmetic, which is the call that unblocked minting.
  4. Specified the deliverable format: zip file into Discord.
  5. Required the output match the existing provenance-page label format (farm, harvest year, serial).
  
  WHY IT MATTERED
  The 38-vs-39 ambiguity was a real blocker — minting the wrong count strands a physical bar without a code or creates one for a bar that doesn't exist. Gary made that call rather than leaving it to guesswork or minting provisionally.
  
  His question about the Python script also surfaced a reporting failure on my side: I had let a failed Edgar write read as though I'd abandoned the sanctioned renderer. Corrected mid-thread.
  
  EVIDENCE
  PR #39 merged 10292fd — 38 branded labels + 38 manifests, zip delivered to Discord #agroverse-qr-codes.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
